property_summary: For all inputs the reference C never returns true when called with an empty _tos array (it requires _tos.length>0), while the mutant that removed that require may return true for _tos of length 0; the test fuzzes the arrays and asserts that calling transfer with the given arrays never returns true when their length is zero (the reference enforces this for all inputs, the mutant violates it for some).
change_summary: Remove the input length require guard, allowing zero-length arrays and therefore possibly no calls but still returning true — changing observable behavior when callers supply empty arrays.
